name: Calendar window context
description: Summarizes the current Chicago-week calendar window and sample item ids for the Kelly agent.

name: Route matrix cache (read-only)
description: Exposes cached drive matrix entry counts for opportunity / route reasoning without calling Google Routes at inference time.

name: Opportunity graph (weekend plans + op counts)
description: Lightweight opportunity graph summary from staged JSON (weekend plans + tentative opportunity cap).

name: Schedule settlement recommendation
description: POST /api/admin/kelly-agent/schedule-settlement returns structured settlement guidance with deterministic fallback.

name: County win-target scenario (election math)
description: Scenario (not prediction) for statewide 50%+1 vs working cushion target, per-county projected turnout, baseline Dem support blend, capacity-weighted vote gain allocation, guardrails, and explainable sub-scores. Human override always.

name: Volunteer capacity and community coverage (operations)
description: County-level staffing, guide gaps, house-party host need, follow-up workload, bilingual/access support flags, and staff call prompts from file-staged inputs. Campaign operations only — not automated voter persuasion or demographic targeting.

name: GOTV commitment allocation
description: County-level allocation of the 5,000 opt-in GOTV commitment-card goal with explainable county target percentages, house-party goals, and capacity workload. Not voter-level targeting.

name: Event success playbook
description: Prepares staff work for event success: host confirmation, guide coverage, volunteer staffing, commitment-card ask, access support, post-event follow-up, and draft automation tasks. Does not send messages.

name: Automation recommendation queue
description: Staged prepare-only queue for suggested email/SMS/phone/task automations with opt-in, STOP/unsubscribe, consent source, suppression, owner, and human approval gates.
